joined_defect.lepton_scope: The electron value is the empirical scale anchor. Muon and tau values multiply that anchor by the fixed finite-effect ratios. The map from those effects to relativistic rest masses is unproved. Displayed digits are fixed-model values; anchor-only uncertainty excludes model and attachment error.

lepton_comparison.uncertainty: anchor-only errors exclude model/attachment error; no confidence interval for the theory

backreaction.reference: Filled negative-energy sea, all fifteen native labels, scalar blank, retained idle conjugate reference.
backreaction.scope: This is the first image under the full unit interaction. Its modal percentages are conditional on the declared pointer success; original success and failure probabilities remain in the record. The Ritz value is a variational estimate, not the exact interacting ground.

joined_source.finding: One explicit finite Hamiltonian joins compact-defect hopping, all native unit Yukawa channels and the quantum scalar. Every occupation and all 343 scalar modes remain in its definition; the full spatial ground and charged poles are not evaluated.
joined_source.pulse_scope: A distinct three-site texture-off member executes all ninety fermion modes through complete H² and H³ actions. A quantum scalar pulse with its dual reference gives a strictly positive distant-pair record. The yes/no measurement retains its full complement; this is no rest-mass or light-cone derivation.

native_vertices.finding: The full thirty-mode local native ground supplies all 900 fermion-pair contact components and thirteen scalar target energies. The scalar moment is derived on that local state, independently of the lepton-only and free-blank controls.
native_vertices.scope: Three interaction channels and three color components do not count physical generations. The minimal neutral contact null directions and the optional sterile zero-energy spectator do not predict neutrino oscillations.

dispersion.scope: anisotropic nearly flat defect bands; no shared relativistic rest interpretation from Gamma energies. These periodic quadratic controls use their own geometry and filled sea; all rows of each sampled Bloch block are retained, while the full momentum continuum and interacting joint source are not computed.

catalogue.scope: Every Standard Model target type has an explicit entry. These seventeen labels do not close the physical catalogue or supply a gravity spectrum. The physical source rest-mass column is unresolved for all seventeen types. The adjacent numbers are empirically calibrated action parameters with their own conventions, including the optional neutrino extension; zero action parameters are not established zero physical masses.
catalogue.clock_test: The specified record-zero uᶜ→up and dᶜ→down dictionary has disjoint GeV-per-source-energy intervals. One common scale cannot match both fixed calibrated targets. This excludes that dictionary, rather than assigning separate clocks.

yukawa.finding: The finite source supplies exact interaction tensors, complete response records and an ordered-correlation correction. These calculations expose how a specified Higgs variation becomes a family coupling, and which parts depend on a declared interaction.

rows.title: Extract every family coefficient
rows.result: The native Higgs tensors admit an exact dual that recovers all 27 complex coefficients from a specified Higgs variation. It recovers the existing trial action exactly; a dynamical Higgs kinetic residue is a separate input.

rows.title: Keep the order of source records
rows.result: Summing every correlation lag gives a nonzero coherent correction I ⊗ J without inserting a phase. The first-order term is not a Yukawa correction. The pairing sector receives the derived second-order term h²Y₃.

rows.title: Recover the specified finite coupling
rows.result: Complete source records invert the declared coupling. Conditional one-loop running and finite spectral controls retain their supplied interaction parameters; no source-to-physical Yukawa matching is inferred.

rows.title: Normalize the complete response
rows.result: Restoring all twelve source modes gives two protected zero directions and a rank-one zero-frequency Schur response. The complete cyclic instrument is dephasing; its full record map has unit singular values.

yukawa.scope: No source-derived physical charged-fermion Yukawa spectrum is established. These finite results make no quark or neutrino mass prediction. A physical Higgs intervention, its kinetic residue and the same-source field and clock attachment are required.

defect_response.principle: A particle assignment is a readout of how a defect propagates and responds. Its charge class constrains the allowed interaction; the coupling depends on the full mode and its response to a scalar intervention.

overlap.finding: One fixed 686-state spatial operator supplies four localized modes. Projecting every local unit scalar insertion onto their complete normalized band gives two doubled response strengths. The local patch reaches the other core through a hopping tail, producing a large overlap hierarchy without family-tagged coefficients.
overlap.scope: These are finite profile diagnostics. The local patch is a declared intervention, not a scalar mode selected by the source. Uniform scalar response has no hierarchy. Four modes give two doubled strengths, not three generations. The common-source panel supplies its own selected free scalar mode and vacuum metric. Interacting poles and a physical generation assignment require their stated attachments.

scalar.finding: On the separate thirty-mode quantum source, varying the scalar occupation cost changes the actual ground polarization and the complete second energy-transfer moment of each removal probe. Every target energy and the one-half failure probability enter the sum.
scalar.formula: H(μ) = V + μN_H; M₂(μ) = Σⱼ wⱼ(μ)[Eⱼ(μ) − E₀(μ)]²
scalar.scope: Decimal summaries of exact enclosed values at μ = 1, in source-clock units. The derivative follows the changed ground state. Scalar occupation cost is not a Higgs field amplitude; these values are neither masses nor Yukawa coefficients.

vertex.finding: The separate 320-state lepton-Higgs source has a declared unit interaction. Complete fermion and scalar records reconstruct its contact vertex, while an actual charged-scalar pulse produces a pair-pointer response with its quantum charge reference retained.
vertex.scope: The scalar spectral moment is 14/5; its finite contact normalization is √(14/5). This is a measured normalization of the specified unit interaction, not an on-shell Yukawa coupling. The pair-pointer slope is measured at zero scalar-pulse angle on the prepared ground. The original ground-preparation probability is 1/160, with all other preparation outcomes retained.

defect_response.source_domains: The overlap, local cost-response and 320-state contact controls retain their separate preparations. The common-source panel states their proved attachments and keeps the control-only normalizations distinct.

calibrated_quarks.finding: These six values belong to an empirically calibrated comparison extension. All nine charged Yukawa couplings and the Higgs scale are fitted inputs; each displayed parameter is y v/√2. The action checks the common mass and current conventions. It does not derive six native quark masses.
calibrated_quarks.scope: All entries use the tadpole-free pure MS-bar Standard Model scheme at μ = 91.1876 GeV. The pinned SMDR 1.3 calibration fits reference observables and checks its forward output. No joint uncertainty has been propagated, and the displayed digits are numerical values of the fixed calibration. These running action parameters are not isolated free-quark poles. Values quoted at 2 GeV, at a quark’s own scale, or in a direct-reconstruction top-mass convention require matching before comparison. No common native-clock or source-to-physical mass map is supplied.

lepton.finding: The squared-eigenvalue ratios are μ/e = 206.770316 and τ/e = 3477.472837. The comparison-only muon residual is +9.83358 ppm against CODATA 2022, or 442.02 experimental standard uncertainties. The PDG 2024 tau comparison is 30.93584 ppm high (about 0.611 experimental standard uncertainties). These are reference-only discrepancies, with no joint likelihood or invented theory error. Two shape parameters have a nonsingular ratio Jacobian; common normalization cancels. Independence of the two prepared cells fixes the phase 2/9. No phase or round count is fitted here. The mass-read double-load effect has trace 5/18, a common factor 5/4 above the separate native-pair effect; their ratios coincide. A physical pole-mass interpretation is an additional premise.

epochs.description: A closed triangular cell has three bounded loads and two opposite face classes. Its 1,296-state kernel executes the native repair and acceptance rule, with all 7,776 attempted records retained. This is a declared finite cell, with no abundance transfer to the full federation.
epochs.finding: For independent uniform initial loads in 0–5 and initial flux zero, the exact persistent occupied-face share is 1007/13824 (7.28443287%). The 128-attempt bracket width is approximately 5.853e-10. For every initial distribution, unresolved probability is at most 25^(−floor(n/32)). The cost is nonincreasing on every branch; it has no physical temperature or energy calibration.

species.finding: For a census of declared code quanta, q = c₁+c₂+c₄+c₅ identifies the quark-labelled total. With Higgs and gauge components admitted, the lepton total can be anywhere from 0 to c₀+c₃. A fermion/boson bit within classes 0 and 3 resolves the aggregate family totals. Three label values resolve the finer up/down and charged/neutral aggregates. These are minimum information requirements; no particle decoder for native flux-face records is implemented.
species.thermal_scope: Comparison only: a massless ideal Standard Model gas at 1 TeV, a common equilibrium temperature, zero chemical potentials, three active-neutrino families and no populated right-handed neutrinos. Counts include antiparticles, physical helicities and all gauge/Higgs components. Number fractions weight fermions by 3/4; energy fractions use 7/8. Their fermion-only quark/lepton split is 80%/20%. Uniform full-code counting gives 75%/25% instead. Interactions, masses and thermal-mass corrections are omitted. No early-Universe abundance match is inferred from the native runs.

symmetry.finding: The solid curve is the class-1 minus class-5 count in one native history on 412 faces. The dashed curve is its exact paired mean with the conjugated history. The theorem covers all finite attempt counts under the stated symmetry premises.

hadron.finding: The paired contrast (mN − mρ)/√σ is 0.599034 ± 0.042860 statistically. Discarding covariance gives 0.044074 for that error. The common scale cancels from mN/mρ in every replica. These one-spacing quenched results do not bound quenching, volume or continuum effects; the contrast has no fit-systematic allowance.

crossover.finding: The declared-chain crossover central value is 161.1298 GeV. Missing shared-reference covariance leaves a compatible statistical SD range [0.11810, 0.13680] GeV under independent run sets, or [0.00000, 0.27631] GeV without that premise. These linearized SD ranges are not confidence intervals. The declared reduction allowance is 1.6113 GeV; no probability law is supplied for that allowance or combined Gaussian significance. At matched physical size Lg₃² = 8, the linear cutoff fit gives 160.8546 ± 0.0720 GeV statistically. The finite-design displacement across fit variants reaches 0.3490 GeV. A three-point linear-plus-quadratic fit has zero residual degrees of freedom. This sensitivity is separate from the declared reduction uncertainty and is not a controlled continuum or infinite-volume error bound.

repair.finding: A known binary preparation and complete addressed current records reconstruct the pair distance using a seven-bit tracked-state index. Exact quotient powers reach 1% total-variation accuracy after 39 attempts for every initial distance law. The bounded controller uses at most 298 retained logical bits, or 311 including the incoming packet. Missing, incompatible or out-of-order records halt inference. The source halts at tape capacity. Preparation, scheduler, program storage and physical implementation are explicit separate inputs.
